reference_scope: full text (Tier B: thresholds and key dates only, no sanction items); text is Bill No. 29/2024 as introduced

reference.quote: Read the first time on 9 September 2024.
comes into operation on a date that the Minister appoints by notification in the Gazette
reference.value: conditional commencement: date appointed by the Minister by Gazette notification

note: No numeric thresholds: the $1,000,000 (social media service provider) vs $1,000 fine tiers in new ss. 61N(2)/42M(2) are penalty maxima (enforcement, excluded at Tier B); '2 or more individuals' in ss. 61MA(4)(a)/42LA(4)(a) describes private communications rather than a cutoff; the election-period windows are not numeric.
